title: Sound Generation Tool
author: deege
selftext:
I created this web app based on a much older app (Bfxr2). I brought the UI into the 2020s, added more sound generators, stereo sounds, sound layering and editing, and a few other things I wished the original site had. You can also connect to it with an AI to control it locally. Nothing goes to a server.

I'd consider it early beta. I'd love to hear any feedback you'd suggest. Missing must have features, or anything that would make it easier to use. 

It's free, and the sounds you create are yours. Nothing leaves your computer.

[https://www.quirkphonic.com](https://www.quirkphonic.com)
